title: On Fitting Flow Models with Large Sinkhorn Couplings
tldr_zh: 作者报告把 Sinkhorn 耦合分片扩到 n≈2×10⁶ 后 OT-FM 才明显获益；n≈256 的微弱收益是小 batch 伪象。
tldr_en: Sharded multi-GPU Sinkhorn couplings with n up to 2M and low epsilon make OT flow matching pay off; n~256 gains were a small-batch artifact.
